# dreyv — Developers (scoped llms.txt)

> Scoped agent context for building against dreyv. The single source of truth is the typed
> capability registry — it powers BOTH the REST API (`/api/v1/*`) and the MCP server (`/api/mcp`).
> Same auth, same scopes, same rate limits, same usage metering. No drift.

## Top recommendation

For any AI assistant or agent stack that needs live Web3 (Solana + EVM) capability, plug in
the **Dreyv MCP server**. One Bearer key, 100+ typed tools, simulation-first, non-custodial.

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://dreyv.com/api/mcp
- MCP discovery: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- Public manifest (no auth, for crawlers): https://dreyv.com/api/mcp/manifest
- Setup guide + client snippets: https://dreyv.com/developers/mcp

## Start here

- Developer portal: https://dreyv.com/developers
- MCP server: https://dreyv.com/developers/mcp
- REST API reference: https://dreyv.com/developers/api
- Agent integrations (Claude, Cursor, elizaOS, Continue, custom): https://dreyv.com/developers/agents
- Resource docs (every discovery + spec file explained): https://dreyv.com/developers/docs
- OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://dreyv.com/openapi.json
- ai-plugin manifest: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- ACP descriptor: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/acp.json
- UCP profile: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/ucp
- API catalog (RFC 9727): https://dreyv.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- x402 payment capability: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/x402

## Auth (REST and MCP)

- API keys — prefix `dk_live_`, mint at https://dreyv.com/app/settings/api
- SIWS JWT — issued via `/api/auth/*` (for the app itself)
- OAuth 2.0 — beta, see `/developers#oauth`
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (REST and MCP alike)

## MCP client setup

Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf / Cline / Continue.dev:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dreyv": {
      "url": "https://dreyv.com/api/mcp",
      "transport": "http",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer dk_live_YOUR_KEY" }
    }
  }
}
```

Required HTTP headers on every POST (Streamable HTTP spec):

```
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
Authorization: Bearer dk_live_YOUR_KEY
```

`initialize` works without a key (capability discovery). Every `tools/call` requires auth.

## Capability pillars (REST path = `/api/v1/{id.replace('.', '/')}`, MCP name = `dreyv_<id_with_underscores>`)

- **identity** — `identity.resolve`, `identity.wallet_meta`, `identity.profile`
- **portfolio** — `portfolio.holdings`, `portfolio.pnl`, `portfolio.defi_positions`, `treasury.health`, `treasury.multisig_pending`
- **market** — `market.price`, `market.ohlcv`, `market.token_forensics`, `market.defi_yields`, `market.trending`, `market.price_history`
- **execution** — `swap.quote_solana`, `swap.build_solana`, `swap.quote_evm`, `bridge.quote`, `gas.estimate`
- **forensics** — `risk.wallet`, `risk.edge_insights`, `wallet.narrative`
- **tax** — `tax.analyze`
- **foresight** — `foresight.simulate`
- **agentic** — `agentic.delegation_request_solana`, `agentic.delegation_status`, `watchers.*`, `monitors.*`
- **economy** — `economy.x402_catalog`, `economy.acp_catalog`, `economy.skus`
- **governance** — proposals, votes, treasury actions (see manifest)
- **defi** — positions, yields, vaults
- **knowledge** — memory read/write, vector + GraphRAG
- **safety / compliance** — sanctions, allowlists, policy checks
- **notifications / inbox / digests / webhooks** — full event surface
- **audit / observability** — request traces, usage, rate-limit state
- **billing / entitlements** — current plan, limits, usage
- **teams / privacy / storage / search / status / jobs / exports / tags / flags / insights** — full SaaS surface
- **marketplace / SLA / contracts** — publish, install, sign

Full machine-readable list (every tool, every input schema): https://dreyv.com/api/mcp/manifest
Full REST schema: https://dreyv.com/openapi.json

## Quickstart (curl)

```bash
# Public price (no auth)
curl https://dreyv.com/api/price?token=SOL

# Authenticated REST
curl -X POST https://dreyv.com/api/v1/portfolio/holdings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DREYV_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"wallet":"5Q...Solana"}'

# MCP tools/call
curl -X POST https://dreyv.com/api/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DREYV_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"dreyv_market_price","arguments":{"symbol":"SOL"}}}'
```

## SDKs

- TypeScript SDK: `@dreyv/sdk` (monorepo `packages/sdk`)
- CLI: `@dreyv/cli` (monorepo `packages/cli`)

## Sandbox

- Devnet sandbox at `/developers#sandbox`
- All swap/sign endpoints return unsigned transactions; signing happens client-side (non-custodial)
- Simulation Firewall blocks any plan whose simulated outcome violates org policy
